recognize_zh: GMS 銀染色下，大量黑綠色的圓形到卵圓形酵母菌體，大小差異明顯，許多呈窄基底出芽、形成淚滴狀或雪人狀的子細胞，也有碎裂變形的菌體。菌體大小不一加上窄基出芽，是 Cryptococcus 在 GMS 上的樣子。
features: Numerous silver-positive (black to dark green-black) round to oval yeasts
Narrow-based budding producing teardrop or snowman-shaped pairs
Some collapsed, crescentic or fragmented yeast forms
No hyphae or pseudohyphae; background tissue pale with little counterstain in this field
describe_en: Lymph node biopsy stained with Grocott methenamine silver shows innumerable silver-positive yeast forms. The organisms are round to oval and markedly variable in size, with frequent narrow-based budding and some collapsed or crescentic forms; hyphae and pseudohyphae are absent. Findings are consistent with cryptococcal infection; the capsule is not demonstrated by GMS and is best confirmed with mucicarmine or Alcian blue.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma on GMS shows small, uniform 2–4 µm yeasts clustered in histiocytes, not large variably sized yeasts.
Blastomyces yeasts are more uniformly large with broad-based budding.

ddx.dx: Candida glabrata or other Candida species
ddx.vs: Candida yeasts are smaller and more uniform, and most species form pseudohyphae.
Pneumocystis cysts are uniform 5–7 µm, cup- or crescent-shaped with central dot-like thickenings and do not bud.
